Describe a recent experience, your favorite food, or something made up. The subject matter is entirely up to you. Write as you would when writing an email or assignment. Please do not write text you have memorized or write frequently. Please write your response in English.

Pudding is a food that is eaten with a spoon. It is soft and viscous.

The 1954 Atlantic hurricane season was an above-average Atlantic hurricane season in terms of named storms, with 16 forming. Overall, the season resulted in $751.6 million in damage, the most of any season at the time. The season officially began on June 15, and in nine days later the first named storm developed.
